findings.description: The bucket is commented as public and has no acl set to private, no public access block, and no bucket policy restricting access, allowing unauthenticated access to potentially sensitive customer data stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including customer master data) are not encrypted at rest.
A customer master file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into a bucket that is publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized parties.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
